logic.note: The LS013B7DH03 serial protocol: write-lines, clear-all and VCOM-only frames with an active-high chip select, LSB-first data (MSB-first senders understood), DISP on / off.

timing.note: A line shows as soon as its 16 bytes arrive; no SPI clock limit (2 MHz) or chip-select setup / hold times are checked.

analog.note: No contrast, viewing angle, or the slow degradation a missing VCOM toggle causes (a warning says so instead).

power.note: About 2 µA for a still image and 17 µA while writing (datasheet: about 4 µW / 50 µW at 3 V); a breakout's regulator and level shifter add their own.

doesNotEmulate: Image degradation from a DC bias
EXTMODE (EXTCOMIN is treated as in use when it toggles)
testOnRealDevice: Toggle VCOM at about 1 Hz, including while the MCU sleeps (EXTCOMIN from an RTC square wave, or a short wake each second)
Check the image in sunlight and in the dark: it has no backlight
Measure the breakout's sleep current: some have a power LED
